faq.q: Why does my share text fail to parse?
faq.a: A share code is text, not a URL. Copy the http link embedded in it and try again.
The tool saves the original video stream the platform serves. Where only a watermarked version exists, nothing is cropped or blurred.

faq.q: Can I keep just the music?
faq.a: Yes. Switch the format toggle to MP3 and download to write the audio track to a file.

faq.q: How do I save it to my camera roll?
faq.a: Open this page in a mobile browser, paste and parse, then tap Save to device. The file lands in your browser downloads; your gallery app can import from there.
